blocks.text: Variants
Shipyard specialties and what each hits hardest.
A variant costs its generalist's price plus a fee per gun (Combat > Weapon Mods); its chevrons and shots share its color.
When to use each variant
Generalist
No weak matchup: the safe pick when you don't know the enemy. Against starbases any variant does better; Disruptor is best.
Pulsar
Cruiser- and carrier-heavy fleets of uncertain mix: never far worse than a generalist against any warship.
Breacher
Destroyers: the best pick against them by the layer math.
Ravager
Corvette swarms, and bombarding worlds (it hits population hardest).
Disruptor
Carriers and starbases: the best pick against them. Weak against corvettes, which need more damage than a generalist.
Inhibitor
Cruisers and carriers (best against cruisers). No gain against corvettes or destroyers.
What each one does
A variant keeps its class's hull; only its chevrons change color, matching its shots (generalists wear yellow).
Which variant against what
Layer math, not battle results; Combat > Matchups has measured duels.
A variant is chosen when a Shipyard builds the ship (Variants research) and stacks with its mark (Ships > Marks).
